def translate_char(source_char, carrier, reverse=False, encoding=False):
    u"""translate unicode emoji character to unicode carrier emoji character (or reverse)

    Attributes:
        source_char   - emoji character. it must be unicode instance or have to set `encoding` attribute to decode
        carrier       - the target carrier
        reverse       - if you want to translate CARRIER => UNICODE, turn it True
        encoding      - encoding name for decode (Default is None)

    """

     """

         source_char = source_char.decode(encoding)

         source_char = carrier.translate(source_char)

def translate_char_list(source_char_list, carrier, reverse=False, encoding=False):
    u"""translate unicode emoji character list to unicode carrier emoji character list (or reverse)
    
    Attributes:
        source_char_list   - emoji character list. it must be unicode instance or have to set `encoding` attribute to decode
        carrier            - the target carrier
        reverse            - if you want to translate CARRIER => UNICODE, turn it True
        encoding           - encoding name for decode (Default is None)
    
    Returns:
        unicode emoji character list
    """
    if encoding:
        source_char_list = [char.decode(encoding) for char in source_char_list]
    if reverse:
        source_char_list = [carrier.translate(char) for char in source_char_list]
    else:
        source_char_list = [char.translate(carrier) for char in source_char_list]
    return source_char_list
